root_cause_analysis.title: Root Cause Analysis for Unimplemented Areas

root_cause.primary: Missing proper error handling middleware for malformed JSON requests
root_cause.technical_details: body-parser was throwing SyntaxError for invalid JSON without proper error handling middleware to catch and format the error response

impact.before_fix: Server logs showing unhandled JSON parsing errors, poor user experience
impact.after_fix: Clean error responses with proper HTTP status codes and user-friendly messages

solution_implemented.approach: Added custom JSON verification middleware and enhanced error handler
components: Custom JSON verification in express.json() options
Enhanced error handler for entity.parse.failed errors
Proper HTTP status codes and error messages
code_changes: Added verify function to express.json() middleware
Enhanced app.use() error handler for specific error types

validation_results.error_response_format: Proper JSON error response with 400 status

root_cause.technical_details: Protected endpoints were accessible without authentication due to lack of middleware to verify tokens and check user roles

impact.before_fix: All protected endpoints accessible without authentication - major security vulnerability
impact.after_fix: Proper authentication required for all protected endpoints with role-based access control

solution_implemented.approach: Implemented comprehensive authentication and authorization middleware
components: Proper error responses for unauthorized access
code_changes: Applied authentication to all protected endpoints
Added proper error responses for auth failures

root_cause.primary: Default rate limiting configuration too aggressive for testing
root_cause.technical_details: Rate limiting was configured with production settings (100 requests per 15 minutes) which was too restrictive for testing and development

impact.before_fix: Testing blocked by rate limiting, development workflow disrupted
impact.after_fix: Environment-appropriate rate limiting with relaxed settings for testing

components: Dynamic rate limiting based on NODE_ENV
Skip rate limiting for health checks
Proper error messages with retry information
code_changes: Implemented skip function for health check endpoints
Added retry information in error messages

Environment-specific configuration is essential for development workflow
